# 3rdparty

## libfuoten

- Upstream: https://github.com/Huessenbergnetz/libfuoten (LGPL-3.0-or-later)
- Version: commit `2cbb164` (2023-03-09, version 0.8.2)
- Kept as a **local copy** in `3rdparty/libfuoten/` (no submodule, no fork). Changes stay here and are not sent upstream.
- Compiled directly into `harbour-sailfeed` via `libfuoten.pri` (qmake). The `fuoten_export.h` generated by libfuoten's CMake is replaced by `libfuoten-qmake/fuoten_export.h`.

### Local changes

All changes against `2cbb164` are also in `patches-libfuoten.diff`, so they can be applied again when libfuoten is updated. Every changed file carries a notice "Modified 2026 by Thomas Sappl for harbour-sailfeed" below its license header, as the (L)GPL-3 asks for modified files.

- **Asynchronous loading of articles with a request ID.** `AbstractStorage::gotArticlesAsync()` used to go to *all* article models of the same storage. A second model then took over the articles of the first one; since the first had already deleted them, this crashed (use-after-free, reproduced in the test). New: `QueryArgs::requestId` and the signal `gotArticlesAsyncForRequest(requestId, articles)`; each model only takes the result of its own query. `gotArticlesAsync()` remains for queries without a request ID.

- **`GetItems` sends the feed/folder ID.** The request never contained the News API parameter `id`, so asking for the items of one feed or folder (type 0/1) returned items of all feeds. Needed for "load older articles" in a feed or folder.

- **One database connection per worker thread.** The storage's worker threads (`SQLiteStorageManager`, `GetArticlesAsyncWorker`, `ItemsRequestedWorker`, `EnqueueMarkReadWorker`, `ClearQueueWorker`) all used the main thread's `fuotendb` connection, although a `QSqlDatabase` connection may only be used in the thread that created it. When a worker and the main thread queried at the same time, the app crashed inside SQLite (reproduced in the desktop test, about one run in ten). Each worker now opens its own connection in `run()` (`WorkerDbConnection` in `sqlitestorage_p.h`) and removes it afterwards. This may also explain the one-time hang at start seen on the device on 8 Oct.

- **`clearStorage()` recreates the database.** It dropped all tables (sign-out, change of account) without recreating them, so the next sign-in or sync crashed. Now the storage is not ready while clearing, and `init()` recreates the empty tables afterwards.
- **Login Flow v2 polling honours "ignore SSL errors".** The polling requests did not, so sign-in in the browser failed with self-signed certificates.
- **`Error` keeps the HTTP status and the network error code** (`httpStatus()`, `networkError()`), so the app can explain errors independent of the translated text.

### Updating libfuoten

```
git clone https://github.com/Huessenbergnetz/libfuoten.git /tmp/libfuoten
rsync -a --delete --exclude .git /tmp/libfuoten/ 3rdparty/libfuoten/
cd 3rdparty/libfuoten && patch -p1 < ../patches-libfuoten.diff
```

Then regenerate the diff file if the patch had to be adjusted.

## Readability.js

- Upstream: https://github.com/mozilla/readability (Apache-2.0, `readability/LICENSE.md`)
- Version: 0.6.0, commit `ab4027a` (2026-07-09), unchanged
- Included as a Qt resource (`harbour-sailfeed.qrc`, `:/js/Readability.js`) and passed into the loaded page with `WebView.runJavaScript()` for the reader mode.
